data.notes: May 2027 has only a partial confirmed music calendar so far: the strongest verified picks are a Francophone emerging-artist final, a major Malian world-music appearance, and a handful of touring club/theatre concerts, while signature summer series such as Piknic Électronik have not yet published confirmed 2027 May dates.

events.title: Carly Rae Jepsen — Day and Night Tour
events.summary: Carly Rae Jepsen brings the Day and Night Tour to MTELUS with Sarah Kinsley. Evenko lists the Saturday show for 7:30 p.m., with doors at 6:30 p.m.

events.title: Salif Keita | La voix d’or de l’Afrique
events.summary: Malian icon Salif Keita returns to Montréal with a new album and a ten-musician band for Place des Arts’ Arts et monde series. The official listing bills the show as world music and Malian music at Théâtre Maisonneuve.

events.title: FKJ — Tyber Tour
events.summary: French multi-instrumentalist and producer FKJ closes the month at MTELUS on the Tyber Tour. Evenko confirms the Montréal performance for May 31 at 8:00 p.m.

events.title: Les Francouvertes — 31st Edition Final
events.summary: The 31st Les Francouvertes competition culminates with its final at Club Soda, where three finalists from the Francophone and Indigenous emerging-music showcase perform. The official competition page confirms the final for May 10, 2027.

events.title: The Warning — Everything’s Falling World Tour
events.summary: Mexican rock trio The Warning bring the Everything’s Falling World Tour to MTELUS with wilt on the bill. Live Nation lists the Montréal date for May 9 at 8:00 p.m.

events.title: Agnes Obel
events.summary: Agnes Obel is confirmed for Théâtre St-Denis as part of her North American tour routing. Ticketmaster and the venue listings place the Montréal performance on May 25 at 8:00 p.m.

events.title: The Limiñanas with Native Sun
events.summary: Blue Skies Turn Black presents French psych-garage band The Limiñanas with Native Sun at Théâtre Fairmount. The venue calendar lists doors at 7:00 p.m. and show at 8:00 p.m.

events.title: Hazlett
events.summary: Australian singer-songwriter Hazlett is confirmed for an 8:00 p.m. show at Théâtre Beanfield. The date appears on Ticketmaster’s Théâtre Beanfield schedule and Hazlett artist ticket page.

events.title: Henge
events.summary: Henge are confirmed for an all-ages show at Théâtre Beanfield. Evenko lists doors at 7:00 p.m. and show time at 8:00 p.m.
